body.x: Molex Korea introduced its connectors and applications at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Molex is a company established in 1984 that has been designing, manufacturing, and supplying the connectors for more than 30 years. Its major product micro connector is being used as parts for mobile phones and appliances, and will be supplied as an auto part.
It also manufactures many kinds of switches and application tools that can be applied for lighting and medical industries.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
